title: Coefficient at the first coordinate
statement: For the fixed Boolean function on the two-dimensional sign cube used as a counterexample to the odd BLR book bound, the Fourier coefficient at the singleton coordinate set $\{0\}$ is $-1/2$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the defining construction of the fixed Boolean function.
